build_EmissionAbsorptionRaymarcher: build a PyTorch module using EmissionAbsorptionRaymarcher to render rays with density and feature tensors
run_EmissionAbsorptionRaymarcher_forward: run EmissionAbsorptionRaymarcher forward pass with rays_densities and rays_features to get rendered features and opacities
build_AbsorptionOnlyRaymarcher: build a PyTorch module using AbsorptionOnlyRaymarcher to compute per-ray opacity values from density tensors
run_AbsorptionOnlyRaymarcher_forward: run AbsorptionOnlyRaymarcher forward pass with rays_densities to compute total light absorption per ray
review_shifted_cumprod: review the _shifted_cumprod helper function that computes shifted cumulative product along the last dimension
